name: Mastiff
appearance: A fawn mastiff with a broad black muzzle, dropped ears, and a heavy chest.

sections.Printed source: DDEX3-14 Death on the Wall, March 1, 2016 release , p. 23. Patrol and kennel context on pp. 11–12.
sections.Traits: Keen Hearing and Smell. The mastiff has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or fall prone.
sections.Patrols and kennels: The Yûlash camp keeps four mastiffs. One accompanies two guards on a patrol that moves through the camp. The patrol calls to unidentified people and demands identification before taking hostile action. The dogs at the kennel are tethered to a rail and cannot move more than 10 ft. from the kennel.
